core.title: Dorma 8600 Series Door Closer Grade 1, Dorma 8616ARPAL

text.description_html:
ADA Compliant Dorma 8600 Series Door Closer

The Dorma 8600 Series features full rack and pinion construction, heavy duty cast aluminum closer body, stamped flat style arm assembly and full architectural cover. Hydraulic control is achieved through separate hex-key non-critical sweep, latch and backcheck adjustments.

Specifications and Features for the Dorma 8615ARPAL Commercial Door Closer:

  • Aluminum Finish
  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Adjustable Back Check
  • Non-Handed
  • Grade 1 (Highest Grade)
  • UL 10C Approved (UL Listed 63Z0)
  • Spring Size: 1-6
  • Tri packed for regular, top jamb or parallel arm mounting
  • ADA Compliant
  • 25 Year Warranty

The Dorma 8615 is ADA Compliant offering adjustable spring power sizes 1 - 6 for use on interior doors requiring less than 5 lbs. of opening force and exterior doors requiring less than 8.5 lbs.
